label: Gentle Muse · Halloween
contract: Every holiday carries a fact somebody softened. I post the real one before the day arrives.

beats.html:
Trick or treat
is younger than jazz.

The phrase does not appear
in North American print
until the 1920s.

One of the earliest
is a 1927 newspaper
in Blackie, Alberta.

The oldest looking part
of the night
is the newest thing about it.
